ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $DE \parallel BC$, and $AE:AC = 2:3$, $AD=6$. What is the length of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $DE\parallel BC$,\\
it follows that $\frac{AE}{AC}=\frac{AD}{AB}$,\\
Given $AE\colon AC=2\colon 3$ and $AD=6$,\\
it follows that $\frac{2}{3}=\frac{6}{AB}$,\\
Solving yields: $AB=\boxed{9}$.
